How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for HPSCB Cooperative Intern Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.hpscb.bank.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 30-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the HPSCB Cooperative Intern recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the HPSCB Cooperative Intern recruitment is 30th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Cooperative Intern post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBA or an equivalent degree in Marketing Management, Cooperative Management, Agri Business Management, or Rural Development Management to be eligible for the Cooperative Intern position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Cooperative Intern role?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Cooperative Intern position is between 21 years and 30 years. Specific age relaxations may apply as per government rules, but these are not detailed in the provided summary.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Cooperative Intern position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Cooperative Intern post will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 25,000. This is a contract-based position.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Cooperative Intern post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Cooperative Intern post announced by the Himachal Pradesh State Cooperative Bank (HPSCB).

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the HPSCB Cooperative Intern recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the HPSCB Cooperative Intern recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the HPSCB Cooperative Intern recruitment. The application is free of charge.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Cooperative Intern role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Cooperative Intern position primarily involves an application screening. Further details on the selection stages can be found in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for the Cooperative Intern position?
faq.answer: The Cooperative Intern position is a contract-based job. This means the employment will be for a fixed tenure as specified by the Himachal Pradesh State Cooperative Bank.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Himachal Pradesh State Cooperative Bank, which is www.hpscb.bank.in. Always refer to the official website for the most accurate information.
